title: Closed pushforward comparison for categorical formal kernels
statement: Let $j:Z\to X$ be a closed immersion of Noetherian schemes [def-weil-closed-immersion] and $Q$ a quasi-coherent ideal on $X$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf]. Choose an Abelian structure on $\operatorname{Coh}(X,Q)$ [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-modules-abelian]. Let $M,N\in\operatorname{Coh}(X,Q)$, $G,D\in\operatorname{Coh}(Z,Q\mathcal O_Z)$ [def-weil-pbc-coherent-formal-module], and morphisms $a:M\to N$, $\alpha:G\to D$. Suppose isomorphisms of underlying inverse systems $e:M\cong j_*G$, $d:N\cong j_*D$ satisfy $d\circ a=(j_*\alpha)\circ e$. For any limiting kernel fork $k$ of $\alpha$, there is an isomorphism of inverse systems $(\operatorname{Ker}(a))_\bullet\cong j_*(k.\mathrm{pt})_\bullet$. This asserts no termwise kernel formula and requires no annihilation hypothesis.

source.place: Tags 087T (lemma-i-star-equivalence), 087W (lemma-inverse-systems-affine), 087X (lemma-inverse-systems-abelian); closed quotient replacement in Theorem 088E. Verified against https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/087T, /087W, /087X and /088E.

proof.text: Use the termwise closed-immersion formal equivalence E and its specified underlying-system isomorphism theta. Compose E.functor with the inclusion of the supported full subcategory to obtain R into Coh(X,Q). Its underlying inverse system is naturally the termwise closed pushforward.

Use the termwise formal pullback functor P of Tag 0887 and its equality after the formal-system inclusion. Whisker the tensor-pullback/pushforward adjunction with the inverse-system index. Restrict this adjunction along the fully faithful inclusions of coherent formal systems, using the equality for P and theta for R (Mathlib Adjunction.whiskerRight and Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful). Thus P is left adjoint to R. R preserves limits, so it sends the given limiting kernel fork k to a limiting kernel fork of R.map alpha.

Compose e and d with the inverse components of theta and lift these isomorphisms through the full-subcategory inclusion. Cancel theta.hom at D and use its naturality at alpha to prove a commuting square between a and R.map alpha. KernelFork.mapIsoOfIsLimit compares the canonical kernel fork of a with k.map R along the resulting arrow isomorphism. Apply the formal-system inclusion to this point isomorphism and compose with theta at k.pt. This gives exactly the required underlying inverse-system isomorphism, independently of which Abelian structure provides kernel(a).

proof_origin.note: Categorical route using the termwise closed-pushforward equivalence (Stacks 087T, 088A) and formal pullback (Stacks 0887). Restrict the whiskered module adjunction to coherent formal systems; right-adjoint limit preservation replaces the affine kernel and local-exactness route.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersion_formalKernel_comparison
    {X Z : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] [IsNoetherian Z]
    (j : Z ⟶ X) [IsClosedImmersion j] (Q : X.IdealSheafData)
    [Abelian (CoherentFormalModule X Q)]
    (M N : CoherentFormalModule X Q)
    (G D : CoherentFormalModule Z (Q.comap j))
    (a : M ⟶ N) (α : G ⟶ D)
    (e : M.obj ≅ G.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
    (d : N.obj ≅ D.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
    (hsquare : a.hom ≫ d.hom =
      e.hom ≫ Functor.whiskerRight α.hom (Scheme.Modules.pushforward j))
    (k : KernelFork α) (hk : IsLimit k) :
    Nonempty ((kernel a).obj ≅ k.pt.obj ⋙ Scheme.Modules.pushforward j)
